ex1.name: Exercise 1 — Familiarisation
ex1.summary: A straight corridor and four to six aircraft. Learn the scan, the label and the three instructions.

ex2.name: Exercise 2 — The bend
ex2.summary: The corridor turns. Eight to ten aircraft, and nothing turns unless you tell it to.

ex3.name: Exercise 3 — The crossing
ex3.summary: Two corridors cross. Eleven to fourteen aircraft, all heading for the same piece of sky.
